context: The agent must install a manual-only caller workflow in gate mode. This scenario tests that no automatic pull-request trigger is added, that gate mode is selected through the Action input rather than any bespoke check logic, and that the agent explains the two enforcement prerequisites a workflow file cannot satisfy: a required status check and the repository setting allowing Actions to approve pull requests.

checklist.name: Caller workflow created
checklist.description: A workflow file exists under .github/workflows/ that contains a step using tesslio/code-review

checklist.name: No automatic pull_request trigger
checklist.description: The workflow has no on.pull_request trigger, so pull-request activity never starts a review

checklist.name: Both manual invocation paths present
checklist.description: The workflow triggers on issue_comment with types [created] and on workflow_dispatch

checklist.name: Dispatch accepts a pull-request number
checklist.description: The workflow_dispatch trigger declares an input for the pull-request number, and that value reaches the Action's pr-number input

checklist.name: Mention guard
checklist.description: The job's if condition requires an issue_comment event to be on a pull request and to match a specific review command string

checklist.name: Gate mode selected via the Action input
checklist.description: The Action step passes mode: gate

checklist.name: No bespoke gating logic
checklist.description: The workflow contains no step that inspects the review outcome and fails the job itself, no custom check-run creation, and no conditional exit based on findings. Gating is left entirely to the Action

checklist.name: Minimal permissions block
checklist.description: The workflow declares permissions with exactly contents: read, issues: write, and pull-requests: write, and no other permission

checklist.name: Pinned revision placeholder
checklist.description: The uses: line references tesslio/code-review at the literal placeholder <full-commit-sha>, not at a branch name, a tag, main, or canary

checklist.name: Summary names the required status check and the job-name detail
checklist.description: summary.md instructs the administrator to enforce the gate through a required status check in branch protection, and states that branch protection names the job rather than the workflow

checklist.name: Summary discloses the manual-cadence enforcement limit
checklist.description: summary.md states that a required status check is only reported by a run triggered against the pull-request head, that comment-driven and dispatched runs are associated with the default branch, and therefore that a required check on this job is not reported on this manual-only cadence. Full credit requires the limitation to be disclosed rather than the summary claiming the required check will block merges as configured

checklist.name: Summary names the Actions approval setting
checklist.description: summary.md states that approving requires the repository setting allowing GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests

checklist.name: Summary describes the refused-review fallback
checklist.description: summary.md explains that when GitHub refuses the requested review event, the Action still publishes the completed review as a visible comment and fails the gate

checklist.name: Summary states the unblocking contract
checklist.description: summary.md states that a blocked pull request does not unblock itself, that a fresh round must be requested against the new head, and that a comment-driven round publishes a review without clearing a required status check
